item.title: Machine Learning Engineer - SAP
item.description:
**Company Description**
At SAP, you will be part of a global environment that values shared learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will work across international teams, exchange knowledge openly, and develop alongside colleagues committed to advancing machine learning engineering practices. SAP's culture encourages curiosity, inclusion, and growth, giving you opportunities to contribute meaningfully no matter your level.
**Job Description**
**What you'll bring** You have hands-on experience building and operating ML systems in production, with solid skills in Python, data pipelines, and ranking or retrieval systems.
* Python proficiency and hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit-learn. * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines at scale. Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, or equivalent. * Solid knowledge of ranking, retrieval, or recommendation systems; experience with multi-signal fusion or semantic search is a plus. * SQL fluency and comfort working with large-scale columnar data stores. * End-to-end ML ownership across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring; experience with A/B experimentation is a plus. * Degree not required for this role.
We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates to be comfortable using AI tools, including agentic AI. Candidates should be able to create effective inputs. They must automate routine tasks and evaluate the quality of AI-generated outputs. Additionally, they should promote the adoption of AI practices within their teams.
**What you'll build** You will build and maintain ML systems that power personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees, covering offline pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops.
* Build and maintain offline ML pipelines for signal extraction, feature engineering, and candidate generation. * Contribute to request-time ranking logic that fuses signals from multiple ML routes into a personalized result. * Extract and transform employee signals; skills, proficiency, and learning history, into reusable, scenario-agnostic feature snapshots. * Design and maintain quality gates that validate ML pipeline outputs before they reach the serving layer. * Build the experimentation infrastructure. This includes A/B schemas, offline evaluation, and ablation testing. These tools will help measure improvements accurately and thoroughly. * Collaborate with Data Scientists, Architects, and Product to refine algorithms and ship end-to-end ML systems.
**Where you belong** You will join a small, high-ownership pod building personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees at scale. The team runs offline ML pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops in production, processing signals from millions of employees. You will work directly alongside Data Scientists, Architects, and Product from day one, shipping end-to-end ML systems.
**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.
We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.
Compensation Range Transparency SAP believes pay transparency is essential to fostering an honest, supportive, and inclusive culture and is an important part of our commitment to pay equity. The salary range for this position is included in the job posting. The actual compensation offered to the successful candidate will fall within that range and will depend on factors such as education, skills, experience, location, and scope of the role, as determined through the selection process. Where applicable, SAP may also provide variable incentive opportunities and additional benefits, subject to the terms of the relevant plans and policies. Any variable incentive amount is target-based, with actual payouts dependent on company and individual performance. Please reference this link for a summary of SAP benefits and eligibility requirements: SAP North America Benefits.
AI Usage in the Recruitment Process For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process. Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
**Job Summary:**
This job will design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex problems. You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to enhance services through innovative AI/ML solutions. Your role will involve building scalable ML pipelines, ensuring data quality, and deploying models into production environments to drive business insights and improve customer experiences.
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**
* Develop and optimize machine learning models for various applications.
* Preprocess and analyze large datasets to extract meaningful insights.
* Deploy ML solutions into production environments using appropriate tools and frameworks.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into products and services.
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models.
**Minimum Qualifications:**
* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and tools for data processing and model deployment.
* Several years of experience in designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning models.
**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**
Preferred Qualifications:
* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, with a dissertation in machine learning
* Strong research record, including first-author publications at highly recognized conferences (for example NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, RecSys, ACL or EMNLP)
* Deep expertise in at least one of: recommender systems and ranking, foundation models for user-behavior or sequential data, NLP and LLMs, or agentic systems
* Highly skilled with agentic coding tools and workflows (for example, Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot) to build, test and ship ML code faster
* Experience designing novel models or methods and validating them with rigorous ablations and evaluation
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and agents, such as fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use or building evaluation frameworks and benchmarks
* Ability to turn research into production systems, shown through internships, applied research or open-source work; familiarity with model serving, containers or cloud ML platforms such as AWS SageMaker
* Experience with PyTorch or JAX and large-scale data tools such as Spark or BigQuery
* Understanding of experiment design, A/B testing and causal inference, and how offline metrics translate to online business outcomes
* Ability to define research directions for open-ended problems and communicate findings clearly to engineering, product and leadership audiences

item.title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Ads - Amazon
item.description:
**Description** Amazon Ads runs one of the largest real-time decision systems in the world. To meet advertiser goals, we process >4 million ad requests per second, and this team decides which of them are worth the compute. We mine a petabyte-scale stream of traffic to tell in-demand, valuable requests apart from wasteful ones, filtering out the noise and forwarding only what brings value to advertisers, all within milli-seconds. Our solutions save millions in compute costs and drive long-term growth for Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses.
Why you'll love this role: The scientific challenge here is scale and signal: large-scale ML on enormous, high-velocity data, optimization and auction dynamics, and causal measurement of what actually moves the business. Generative AI and LLMs are tools you reach for when they help, not the point of the work. The impact also reaches beyond Amazon: we donated the Dynamic Traffic Engine (DTE) to the IAB Tech Lab as an open-source framework that lets demand-side platforms signal which bid requests they value, so supply-side platforms send fewer wasteful ones and QPS waste drops across the whole programmatic supply chain. We are a highly motivated, collaborative team with an entrepreneurial spirit and a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. You will work alongside talented engineers, product managers, and scientists in a culture that rewards bias for action, innovation, and experimentation. What makes this role unique is the combination of scientific rigor with real-world impact at a scale very few systems reach.
Your impact and career growth: Amazon Ads is investing heavily in AI and ML, creating room for scientists to innovate and make their mark. As an Applied Scientist, you will own the science for well-defined supply-optimization problems and take your work end to end, from framing the approach through experimentation and into production with measured business impact. You will partner closely with engineers to productionize your models and with product managers to tie your science to customer and advertiser outcomes. You will share your findings, begin to mentor teammates, and grow your influence on the team's technical direction over time. This is your opportunity to do high-rigor applied science in one of the fastest-growing businesses at Amazon.
Learn more about Amazon Ads: https://advertising.amazon.com/
Key job responsibilities
**As An Applied Scientist In Amazon Ads, You Will**
* Conduct hands-on data analysis and build large-scale ML models and pipelines for supply optimization. * Take your models end to end, from proof of concept through experimentation, optimization, and deployment into production, working closely with software engineers to productionize them and with product managers and fellow scientists along the way. * Design and run A/B experiments and causal analysis to validate hypotheses, draw insights from petabyte-scale data, and measure real business impact. * Research and apply advanced ML, including generative AI and large language models, to demand prediction and traffic filtering. * Drive end-to-end optimization projects that tackle ambiguous problems at massive scale, developing scalable, efficient processes for model development, validation, and deployment that optimize traffic monetization while maintaining customer experience.
**Basic Qualifications**
* 3+ years of building models for business application experience * PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development
